source_column_6: Purpose

source_column_2: Raspberry Pi 5 Model B, 8 GB
source_column_6: Runs live command decoding, camera control, LiDAR processing and the results viewer.

source_column_2: Official Raspberry Pi 5 Active Cooler
source_column_6: Cools the Pi during operation. Keep the airflow path clear.

source_column_2: SanDisk Extreme PRO 64 GB A2 microSDXC, SDSQXCU-064G-GN6MA
source_column_6: Stores the operating system, program, photographs, distance results and command logs.

source_column_2: Official Raspberry Pi 5 RTC battery
source_column_6: Retains the clock through power-off. Set and verify the date/time before each run.

source_column_2: Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 Standard; 12 MP autofocus, normal field of view, integrated IR-cut filter
source_column_6: Captures target images and supports visual alignment of the LiDAR. Software applies the requested filter.

source_column_2: Pi 5 Standard–Mini camera FPC cable; 22-pin to 15-pin, approximately 300 mm
source_column_6: Connects the camera to the Pi. Provide strain relief and a loop for the verified pan travel.

source_column_2: Genuine RTL-SDR Blog V3 USB receiver; RTL2832U with R820T2/R860 tuner, SMA female
source_column_6: Receives NASA’s 144–148 MHz FM signal for live 1200-baud AX.25/APRS decoding. Receive only.

source_column_2: Passive 144–148 MHz receive antenna kit; 50 Ω, matching coax, SMA male plug and insulated mount
source_column_6: Receives the command broadcast. Match antenna and cable; keep the assembly within the rover size limit.

source_column_2: Shielded USB-A male to USB-A female extension cable; 30–50 cm
source_column_6: Allows separation of the SDR from motor wiring, switching converters and other interference sources.

source_column_2: Waveshare 7inch HDMI LCD (C), Rev 4.1; 1024 × 600 capacitive touch, with protective mount
source_column_6: Displays results at PER. Keep combined USB/fan draw within 1.6 A after confirmed 5 A power negotiation; measure with all devices operating.

source_column_2: Display cable kit: micro-HDMI male to HDMI-A male; USB-A male to micro-USB-B data cable
source_column_6: Connects display video, touch and USB power. Count suitable bundled cables toward this kit.

source_column_2: Benewake TF03-100 UART/CAN version, DFRobot SEN0328; 100 m nominal range, IP67, 3.3 V TTL UART, 115200 baud / 8N1
source_column_6: Measures distance for H commands. Use regulated 5.2 V, aim at the intended board, and record valid results in feet.

source_column_2: CP2102 USB-A to UART adapter; 3.3 V TX/RX logic, Linux support, 115200 baud or faster; TX, RX and GND terminals
source_column_6: Links LiDAR to the Pi. Cross TX/RX and join GND; leave adapter VCC disconnected. Do not use an RS-232 adapter.

source_column_2: TF03 power/UART cable or mating pigtail; match the supplied sensor revision and expose VCC, GND, TX and RX
source_column_6: Connects LiDAR power and data. Connector allowance; use a suitable supplied cable instead if included.

source_column_2: Tower Pro MG996R Robot 180° positional servo, with matching metal horn; purchase conditional on required pan travel
source_column_6: Pans the camera/LiDAR platform in calibrated 30° steps. Confirm total travel with NASA before purchase; the handbook does not specify it.

source_column_2: FEETECH FS90 positional micro servo; 4.8–6 V, approximately 120° travel, 9 g, with matching horn; not FS90R
source_column_6: Tilts the LiDAR automatically. Accepts 3.3 V PWM from the shared PCA9685; use its own regulated power branch.

source_column_2: PCA9685 16-channel 12-bit PWM breakout with headers; VCC and I²C pull-ups at 3.3 V
source_column_6: Controls both servos at a common calibrated servo frequency. Keep separate servo power rails off the shared V+ bus.

source_column_2: SN74AHCT125N buffer kit: IC, 14-pin socket, one 100 nF ceramic capacitor and one 10 kΩ input pull-down
source_column_6: Converts pan-servo PWM from 3.3 V to 5 V. Power from the pan UBEC; common GND; fix unused inputs and enable pins to defined levels.

source_column_2: Shared pan mount: bearing-supported platform, MG996R bracket, camera plate with adjustable fixed elevation, fasteners, hood and cable restraints
source_column_6: Supports the camera and LiDAR tilt assembly. Revised fabrication allowance; verify payload, balance, backlash and full cable clearance.

source_column_2: TF03 tilt cradle, FS90 bracket and pan-platform adapter; balanced bearing-supported pivot, revision-matched sensor mounting hardware
source_column_6: Provides LiDAR elevation adjustment. Fabrication allowance; calibrate beam alignment and verify that the beam hits the intended board.

source_column_2: Dedicated task LiPo battery: 3S, 11.1 V nominal, 2200 mAh, ≥25C continuous; 12.6 V fully charged; XT60 main connector and 4-pin JST-XH balance lead
source_column_6: Powers task electronics only; 24.42 Wh nominal. Local budget estimate; verify brand, connectors and pack condition. Measure runtime through results review; keep separate from the drive battery.

source_column_2: Separate insulated battery mounting kit: rigid tray/enclosure, cushioning, retaining straps, fasteners and protected cable exits; fit the supplied 2200 mAh pack
source_column_6: Secures and electrically isolates the battery, separately from other components as required by the handbook. Fabrication allowance; include it in rover mass and size checks.

source_column_2: Task battery main connection/protection kit: XT60 mating connector, short 14 AWG leads, covered 7.5 A fuse and holder (≥32 V DC), retained master switch rated ≥10 A at 24 V DC
source_column_6: Main fuse close to battery positive, then switch, guard and branch distribution. Extra to the four branch fuses. Allowance; confirm 7.5 A selection with measured load/inrush and component ratings.

source_column_2: Kemo M148A battery guard: adjustable 10.4–13.3 V cutoff, 10 A without added cooling; switches the negative return. Set and bench-verify approximately 10.5 V cutoff
source_column_6: Delayed pack-level cutoff; not individual-cell protection. All task returns must pass through its load side: no chassis/USB bypass. Auto-reconnects about 0.8 V above cutoff; shut down and switch off after an alarm. Import budget allowance.

source_column_2: Adjustable per-cell LiPo voltage alarm/tester: supports 3S via 4-pin JST-XH balance connector; individual-cell display and audible alarm; set approximately 3.6 V/cell
source_column_6: Early low-cell warning; does not disconnect power. Verify threshold against pack guidance. Connect only to the balance lead, insulated from task ground; unplug after use. Stop before continued discharge.

source_column_2: 52Pi EP-0225 Pi 5 PD power board; 9–24 V DC input, USB-PD 5.15 V / 5 A output; supplied 5 A-capable USB-C cable and mounting hardware
source_column_6: Powers the Pi from the protected dedicated task battery. Confirm 5 A PD negotiation and input above 9 V during peak load. Use only one input.

source_column_2: Center-positive DC input pigtail; exact plug and current rating matched to the supplied EP-0225 board
source_column_6: Connects the protected task supply to the Pi power board. Verify polarity and fit before energizing.

source_column_2: Genuine Hobbywing UBEC 3A; 2–6S input, output set to 5 V
source_column_6: Powers the MG996R and its PWM buffer separately from the Pi. Verify voltage during pan movement and starting load.

source_column_2: DFRobot DFR0379 adjustable DC-DC buck converter; 4–40 V input, 3 A maximum; ≤2 A recommended without extra cooling; set output to 5.2 V
source_column_6: One for LiDAR, one for FS90. Meter before connection; keep LiDAR at 5.0–5.5 V under load. Separate positive outputs; common protected task GND.

source_column_2: 1000 µF, 25 V low-ESR electrolytic capacitor; e.g. Panasonic EEU-FR1E102E
source_column_6: One at each load: pan servo, LiDAR and tilt servo. Observe polarity; check start-up and transient stability.

source_column_2: 100 µF, 25 V electrolytic capacitor for converter input decoupling
source_column_6: One across each DFR0379 input, close to the converter. Budget allowance.

source_column_2: 100 nF, ≥50 V X7R ceramic capacitor
source_column_6: Two converter-input bypasses and two load bypasses. The separate buffer kit includes its own fifth 100 nF capacitor.

source_column_2: Task branch harness: 4 covered fuse holders; 1 × 5 A, 1 × 3 A and 2 × 1 A time-delay fuses, all ≥32 V DC; short 14 AWG distribution feed, 18 AWG branches, terminals and heat-shrink
source_column_6: Pi input: 5 A; pan UBEC: 3 A; each DFR0379: 1 A. Feed from the task master switch and battery guard. Allowance; verify fuse, wire and inrush ratings.

source_column_2: Vented task enclosure and signal-wiring kit: standoffs, perfboard, glands, locking connectors, Pi I²C leads, UART leads and two servo signal/power leads
source_column_6: All task grounds join on the battery guard’s load side. Keep them isolated from raw battery negative, chassis and drive-system grounds. Separate regulated positive rails. Allowance.

source_column_2: Existing 2–6S LiPo balance charger, matching PSU and charging/storage bag; compatible XT60 charge lead and 3S JST-XH balance adapter
source_column_6: Reuse the charger/bag already budgeted for the rover. Allowance only for missing leads. Off-rover 3S LiPo balance charge: 4.2 V/cell, ≤2.2 A or the pack’s lower limit. Disconnect rover electronics for charging.

source_column_2: Software: Raspberry Pi OS 64-bit; compatible rtl-sdr/rtl_fm, ALSA audio routing, Dire Wolf, Picamera2, OpenCV, Python, pyserial and PCA9685 I²C driver
source_column_6: Free software foundation for reception, camera, servo and LiDAR interfaces. Install compatible versions and test the complete receiver chain.

source_column_2: Team-developed task controller and results viewer: live AAA/B/C/D/E/F/G/H/ZZZ parser, pan/aim calibration, filter state, timestamped image recorder and LiDAR logger
source_column_6: Develop/test autonomous commands, calibrated aiming, replacing filters (G = normal colour), timestamped images and fresh valid H readings (cm ÷ 30.48). Restore commanded view; save each result promptly for PER; provide safe shutdown.

source_column_6: Planning estimates; obtain supplier quotes. Excludes shipping, taxes and paid labour. Reused charger/bag not repurchased. USD total converted before rounding.
